output.reason: [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] tells operators to move Provider packages to "v2 versions", using a single example (provider-aws-s3:v2.0.0). It does not say which provider package versions lack support for namespaced managed resources, and it says existing cluster-scoped MRs "continue working unchanged". The proposed condition (any Provider with spec.package set) matches every Provider, including ones already on v2 releases, so it is too broad. To decide, I need evidence of which provider versions per provider are below the support threshold, and what fails if the step is skipped.
